instructions: In Java, a variable is a container that holds a value. You must declare the type before the variable name.
task: Create an int variable named 'age' with value 25. Print it.
hint: Use 'int' type before variable name: int age = 25;
title: Declare Int

task: Create double 'price' with value 9.99. Print it.
title: Declare Double

instructions: String stores text. Use double quotes.
task: Create String 'name' with value "Mimo". Print it.
title: Declare String

task: Create boolean 'isActive' with value true. Print it.
title: Declare Boolean

instructions: You can add two int variables.
task: Create int a = 10, b = 20. Print a + b.
title: Add Numbers

task: Create double x = 10.0, y = 3.0. Print x / y.
title: Double Division

task: Create int x = 5. Cast to double and print.
title: Int to Double

instructions: Cast double to int with (int). Decimal is removed.
task: Create double d = 9.99. Cast to int and print.
title: Double to Int

task: Create String first = "Hello", last = "World". Print "Hello World".
title: String Concat

task: Create int a = 17, b = 5. Print a % b.
title: Modulo

instructions: A for loop repeats a block of code.
task: Write a for loop that prints 1 to 5, each on a new line.
title: For Loop

instructions: A while loop repeats until condition is false.
task: Print 1 to 3 using while loop.
title: While Loop

instructions: A do-while loop runs at least once.
task: Print 1 to 3 using do-while loop.
title: Do-While Loop

instructions: Nested loops: loop inside a loop.
task:
Print pattern:
*
**
*** using nested loops.
hint: Outer loop rows, inner loop columns.
title: Nested Loop

task: Loop from 1 to 10. Break when i == 5. Print each.
title: Break Loop

task: Loop 1 to 5. Skip 3 using continue. Print each other.
title: Continue Loop

task: Create array {10, 20, 30}. Print each with enhanced for.
title: Enhanced For

task: Sum numbers 1 to 5 using for loop. Print result.
hint: int sum = 0; for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) sum += i;
title: Sum Loop

task: Use while(true) loop. Break when i > 3. Print 1, 2, 3.
title: Infinite Loop

task: Calculate 5! using for loop. Print result.
hint: int fact = 1; for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) fact *= i;
title: Factorial Loop

instructions: A class is a blueprint for objects.
task: Create class 'Person' with method greet() printing 'Hello'. Create object and call greet().
title: Create Class

instructions: Constructor runs when object is created.
task: Create class 'Person' with constructor setting name. Create object with 'Sodex' and print p.name.
title: Constructor

instructions: Fields are variables inside a class.
task: Create class 'Car' with String brand. Set brand to 'Toyota' and print.
title: Class Fields

instructions: Methods can take parameters and return values.
task: Create class 'Calculator' with method add(a, b) returning sum. Print add(5, 3).
hint: int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
title: Class Methods

task: Create class 'Car' with brand. Create 2 cars: 'Toyota' and 'Honda'. Print both brands.
hint: Each object has its own fields.
title: Multiple Objects

task: Create class 'Counter' with int count. Method increment() adds 1. Call twice and print count.
title: Modify Fields

task: Create class 'Animal' with sound() 'Generic'. Create 'Dog' extends Animal with sound() 'Woof'. Print Dog's sound.
title: Inheritance

instructions: Use super to call parent constructor.
task: Animal constructor sets name. Dog extends Animal and passes 'Buddy' via super. Print dog.name.
title: Super Keyword

instructions: Static methods belong to class, not object.
task: Create class 'MathUtil' with static method square(x) returning x*x. Call MathUtil.square(5).
hint: static int square(int x) { return x * x; }
title: Static Method

task: Create class 'Bank' with private int balance. Add setBalance and getBalance. Set 100 and print.
hint: private int balance; use getBalance() and setBalance().
title: Encapsulation
